title: Backend Cafe

posts.title: How to use winston as the Fastify logger
posts.description: Swapping pino for winston in Fastify breaks request logs, serializers and route log levels. Learn why, and fix it with a custom LogController.

posts.title: How we release Fastify packages without npm tokens

posts.description: Who can publish fastify to npm tonight? Here is how we answered that question with code, and the three supply chain fixes you can copy.
